Definition: from G2228 and G4007; than at all (or than perhaps, than indeed):--than.
BiblicalUsage: Eper means than — a word of comparison, and John uses it once to expose a sad trade: men loved the praise of men more than the praise of God. Than is where the choice shows.
TheologicalSignificance: We choose the praise we can hear over the praise we cannot see, and this one comparison explains so much compromise.
